_doc: Hit weight (docs/DASHES_AND_ABILITY_FEEL.md §5.4): three tiers with a fixed hit-stop and shake, the tier of every Hunter ability, and the stacking caps that keep a team fight readable. hitstop_ms: how long the struck body holds (and the attacker too on a melee hit when attacker is true). The shake of each tier is its <tier>_hit class in content/rules/shake.json (the struck player's camera only; only heavy shakes). flash_ms: how long the struck body flashes white (Ent.flash_t; a tick flashes the light one). confirm_db: the volume of the tier's own confirm sound layered on your hit (hit_<tier>, ImpactWeight.confirm); a kit never sets its own (docs/DASHES_AND_ABILITY_FEEL.md §5.4 hit-feel table). boki: the tier of a summoned Boki's hits (its basic bite, its tagged ability, throw and recall hits). Hunters: arch id -> ability key (lmb, rmb, dash, e, x, or a kit's own hit tag such as rock or fan) -> tier. --impact-weight-check asserts every damaging ability has one.
